what: The finder walk's table (Facts.lean's finderFacts, check.py's choosing): each collision premise or event with the positions of its finder arguments (heads); the constructors of which the walk reads only the finder's output fields (fields); the constants it refuses by name, a finding at each (refuse); those it passes by name, going on into their arguments (pass); and, beside the structures of the fields rows, the types a finder argument may have (types: a game, its strategy, and the Option of a pair an output map returns). Every name is Lean's and every position a finder's, or the check fails (choosing.table). finder_gate.py holds it to only refusing more.
